releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.132:
- COMMERCIAL WEIGHT SCALE & LIQUOR MATH AUTOMATION: Full integration for Torrey price computing and commercial weight scales in Pounds (lb). Automatically converts bottle weight to net liquor grams, fluid ounces, and remaining shots in real-time with zero manual math.
- VISUAL MENU EDITING & REORDERING: Products and Sub-Tabs now feature dedicated direction controls (Move Left / Move Right) and immediate one-touch Delete buttons directly on cards.
- SUB-TAB MODIFICATION: Full Rename, Move, and Delete controls for department Sub-Tabs (Cognac, Tequila, Whiskey, etc.), automatically syncing assigned catalog products.
- TOUCH KEYBOARD AUTO-DISMISS: Virtual on-screen keyboard automatically and cleanly hides whenever modal dialogs close or terminal locks due to inactivity.
- ALCOHOL CATALOG EDIT & DELETE ACTIONS: Clear, prominent Edit and Delete action buttons across bottle catalog tables.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings verified across all integrity auditors.
